name: Zangetsu Community Sources
description: Community-maintained Zangetsu providers. These sources do not host video files.

settings.label: TMDB API Key (optional; blank uses app default)
settings.description: Your personal TMDB v3 API key. Leave blank to use Zangetsu’s built-in key. Sent only to TMDB.

settings.label: Stremio Add-on URLs (manifest URLs; comma/newline separated)
settings.description: One or more Stremio-compatible add-on manifest URLs. Add-ons provide streams; this repository does not host video.

settings.label: Max streams per add-on (limit results from each add-on)
settings.description: Maximum number of streams considered per configured add-on.
